## Quality checklist

Before submitting, confirm each item:

- [ ] Questions test **how to think**, not what to memorize
- [ ] No definition questions ("What is X?")
- [ ] No list-memorization questions ("Name the phases of X")
- [ ] No trivia ("What port does X use?")
- [ ] Key points capture methodology indicators, not keyword lists
- [ ] Multiple valid approaches could score well
- [ ] Would be useful in a real interview
